title: Call-centre orders by district
description: Phone orders sent to the store that serves the customer's district. A Serving store field on Territory (the shop's own district tree): the store that ships call-centre orders for that territory, or, left empty, the store of the territory above it. A button on a draft Sales Order, Send to store, that a Sales User or Sales Manager presses in Desk: the service reads the order with the app's own user, walks its territory up the tree to the first Serving store, and writes that store's warehouse on the order and on every line; the form reloads; a store's own tax or prices may change the total, and the answer says so. Pressed again, it changes nothing. A bundle's parts take the store too. Each store finds its orders in the Sales Order list filtered on its own Set Source Warehouse; a User Permission on a store's warehouse hides orders sent to other stores, not an order whose Set Source Warehouse is empty. Removing the app removes the Serving stores (its export keeps a copy). Each press sends the order's name and territory, the pressing user and the language; the service then reads the whole order (its customer, addresses, lines and prices) and writes it back with the new warehouse, keeping none of it. The install makes the app's own user and its role PP CCO Integration, gives the role read on Sales Order (the record the feed follows), and, from role_rights, write on Sales Order and read on Territory, Customer, Address and Warehouse. The order's save reads its customer's addresses, so the app's user reads them too. The role reaches every sales order, customer and address (suppliers' and the company's too, as a Sales User reads them): it belongs to the app's user alone. The feed PP CCO Routing feed names that user. A service serving many shops is handed the user's key by the shop's site itself. allowed_urls is the programme bench's address; a partner writes its own.

custom_fields.label: Serving store
custom_fields.description: The store whose warehouse ships call-centre orders for customers in this territory. Leave it empty to use the store of the territory above.
